'''Middle Acrola''' is a sub-continent located in the northern hemisphere. It is bordered the [[South Acrola]] to the south, [[North Acrola]] to the north, and the [[Hinsakian Ocean|Great Hinsakian Ocean]] to the east. The sub-continent covers around {{convert|12,671,321|km2|sqmi|abbr=on}} of land, making it the 20th largest sub-continent in the world, with a total of about 111,363,641 as of 1765, making it also the 19th largest continent by population.
